title: Corporate Events
metaTitle: Corporate Event Venue in Mission Beach, San Diego
description: Host a corporate event, team outing or client gathering at Miss B's Coconut Club in Mission Beach, San Diego with flexible indoor and outdoor event space.
cardDesc: Company outings, team celebrations and client events with flexible Mission Beach space, food, drinks and private-event options.
body: Miss B's Coconut Club offers a relaxed Mission Beach setting for company outings, client events, team celebrations and holiday gatherings at 3704 Mission Blvd.
Use the tropical dining room, outdoor patio or a larger venue configuration depending on your group. Food, drinks, staffing and space can be planned around the format of the event.
includes: Full venue or partial buyout options
